title: Late Delivery Claims: Delivery-Charge Refund Calculation Sheet
content:
Refund Operations calculation sheet for the delivery-charge refund on an approved Delivery Claims Late Delivery Claim.

**Calculation.** The delivery-charge refund on an approved Late Delivery Claim is the order's effective shipping fee and surcharge paid, as shown on the order. The refund is rounded to the nearest cent once, on the final figure.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| effective shipping fee | the shipping fee shown on the order — the fee actually charged after any waiver, as distinct from the list fee of the delivery service in the Online Orders service schedule |
| surcharge | the surcharge shown on the order |

## How the figure is assembled

- The guarantee refund basis is the effective shipping fee plus the surcharge.
- The proportions of the guarantee refund basis that are refunded are multiplied together and applied once to the guarantee refund basis, giving the refunded delivery charge; they do not act on one another's results.
- *Hypothetical:* proportions of 75% and 90% of a guarantee refund basis of 20.00 USD multiply to 67.5%, which applied once to the basis gives a refunded delivery charge of 13.50 USD.
- Tax on the refunded delivery charge, where the order bears any, is added to the refunded delivery charge.
- Nothing is rounded along the way: the single rounding to the nearest cent falls on the amount booked.

## Worked figure (hypothetical order)

An order showing an effective shipping fee of 17.00 USD and a surcharge of 2.50 USD: the delivery-charge refund is 17.00 plus 2.50, that is 19.50 USD.
